# A dust puff where a meteor strikes the planet: three overlapping faceted balls, lit mauve.
new
material new Dust --base-color 0.431 0.318 0.506 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name P0 --radius 0.3 --subdivisions 1 --location 0 0 0.2
add mesh ico-sphere --name P1 --radius 0.22 --subdivisions 1 --location -0.28 -0.05 0.12
add mesh ico-sphere --name P2 --radius 0.24 --subdivisions 1 --location 0.27 -0.05 0.15
select P0 P1 P2
material assign Dust
active P0
join
shade flat
export puff.glb
